Three.js 0.160.0

Required ES modules vendored from the official three@0.160.0 npm package.
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160
License: MIT; see LICENSE. No modifications to upstream files.

The upstream build/three.module.js file is stored as three.module.js here; its contents are unchanged. This avoids tooling that excludes directories named build from distributions.
